purpose: Presentation-layer card database for the Together City gemstone marketplace. One card per stone, styled after the editorial reference (arched trait words over the stone, serif display name, soft description). Joins to gemstones.json on id/sku.
imageNote: Images live at /assets/gems/<id>.webp (real photography, white/near-white backgrounds). Cards render on pure white so the photos merge seamlessly; use mix-blend-mode:multiply on the img for off-white photo edges.

cardAnatomy.badge: Card number in a thin circle (optional, as in reference 2/3)
cardAnatomy.traitArc: Three keywords arched over the stone image, letter-spaced uppercase
cardAnatomy.description: 2–4 warm sentences, 'believed to' hedging — no medical or financial claims
cardAnatomy.theme: background / title / body / accent hex tokens per card

cards.description: The king of gems glows with a fire all its own. Ruby is believed to kindle confidence, courage, and the warmth of true leadership — a stone for those ready to step into the light and be seen.

image.alt: Faceted oval pigeon-blood ruby on a soft blush background

wearing.whatYouFeel: Wearers traditionally describe a slow build of warmth and self-assurance — speaking up comes easier, mornings feel more decisive, and there is a new willingness to be seen and to lead rather than wait.
wearing.note: Traditional accounts; experiences vary. Not medical advice.

cards.whyRecommended: Its planet is the Sun — soul, authority, vitality, and the father in the kundali. It is prescribed to strengthen a favourable Sun, never to pacify an afflicted one. In this marketplace it is recommended as Life Stone for Leo lagna, as Fortune Stone for Sagittarius lagna, for a Leo Moon sign, during Sun mahadasha, and for number 1 in numerology.

cards.description: Born of moonlit waters, the pearl carries a quiet, luminous calm. It is believed to soothe the mind, steady the emotions, and deepen intuition — a gentle companion for restful nights and clear mornings.

wearing.whatYouFeel: Most report a cooling of the temper first: sleep deepens, reactions soften, and emotional highs and lows level into a steadier, kinder calm within the first weeks.
wearing.note: Traditional accounts; experiences vary. Not medical advice.

cards.whyRecommended: Its planet is the Moon — the mind itself in Jyotish, ruling emotion, memory, and the mother. It is prescribed when the Moon is favourable but weak, to nourish rather than excite. In this marketplace it is recommended as Life Stone for Cancer lagna, as Fortune Stone for Scorpio lagna, for a Cancer Moon sign, during Moon mahadasha, and for number 2 in numerology.
